title: Monsanto chemicals sprayed in Vietnam cause birth defects

tellings.quote: the chemicals that Monsanto was using. They started shipping over to like Vietnam and third world countries that didn't have the regulatory guidelines and oversight and spraying crops with all these chemicals that then started creating birth defects.

plain: The chemical company Monsanto shipped its chemicals to Vietnam and other poorer countries without strict rules or oversight, where they were sprayed on crops and "started creating birth defects", according to Brigham Buhler, a businessman in the health industry. He tells Michels this as something he heard from others, and offers it as an example of a company pushing harmful products where regulators could not stop it.
